refnamediv.refpurpose: set filename used for admin command logging

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: g_adminLog sets the filename used for admin command logging. Relative filenames are resolved beneath fs_homepath/fs_game, so the default writes fs_homepath/fs_game/admin.log. Parent directories are created when needed. An existing leading mod-directory prefix is accepted once; use admin.log rather than xmod/admin.log in new configurations. Explicit absolute custom filenames remain supported. The file is always appended to. A value of "" will disable this functionality.
